Dated run · October 25, 2026

A real test run.
A bounded conclusion.

AegisPR compared two commits of a controlled public GitHub PR. The same model-generated usage example ran in isolated Docker on each commit. The output changed consistently; three fresh Nemotron intent reviews called it unintended. The product's overall status remains INCONCLUSIVE because model votes are advisory, not proof of a confirmed regression.

Scope first. This is a controlled PR with a deliberately seeded boundary change, not an independent real-world benchmark. This page is a public, read-only evidence viewer. It cannot run arbitrary PRs, access the private deployment, or spend model tokens.

01 / How the process ran

From code change to evidence

  1. 01

    Ingest the PR

    Fetch the public diff and pin both immutable commits.

  2. 02

    Rank context

    Score relevant repository files on the Dell RTX 3050 Ti using CUDA. This local workload is not a Nebius GPU instance.

  3. 03

    Plan the test

    The test plan was generated earlier by nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning through Nebius Token Factory and reused from the response cache in this run.

  4. 04

    Execute both commits

    Run the same four-case Python output example in isolated Docker on base and head, then repeat changed observations twice per side.

  5. 05

    Review intent

    Three new paid intent-review calls compared the observed outputs with the PR title, description and commit message.

02 / Branch observations

The boundary moved.

Every base/head execution and each of the two confirmation reruns per side exited successfully. The difference is in the printed values, not a test-process failure.

The generated file printed keys named “old” and “new” within each branch, but both keys called that branch's own function. AegisPR compared the separate pinned-commit executions. Do not read those within-branch keys as an additional comparison.

03 / What the evidence supports

Advisory intent, deterministic status.

All three fresh Nemotron votes read the change as conflicting with the stated behavior-preserving refactor.

Overall AegisPR statusINCONCLUSIVE

Intent votes are not an automatic confirmed-regression verdict; a human must review the contract and PR intent.
